@@U03648@@
I'll come, too.

@@U03650@@
What a remarkable trinity!
God and man and spirit all in step!
(忒尔喀涅斯众神 OF 罗得岛 appear on hippocamps and sea dragons,
brandishing 涅普顿: trident.)

@@U03652@@
We forged this trident for 涅普顿,
and with it he rules the wildest of waves.
When the Thunderer unleashes his pregnant clouds,
涅普顿 answers the horrible rumble
by rousing the sea to a violent response.
As bolts of lightning plunge jaggedly downward,
涅普顿’s waves dash upward to meet them,
wave upon waye,
mountain high.
And whoever in ships is caught in between
is tossed and blown till the sea overwhelms them,
dragging them down to the sea’s watery deeps.
And so, he’s lent us his scepter for the day,
allowing us peace and joy in our play.

@@U03654@@
Welcome, devotees of 赫利俄斯,
Bless¢d ones who honor light,
Join us as we honor Luna,
Glorious goddess of the night!

@@U03656@@
Dearest of goddesses aloft in your orbit,
with what delight you hear your brother praised,
lending an ear to bless¢d 罗得岛,
where a neverending hymn to him is raised.
At the start and at the close of his daily round,
he looks down upon us with his fiery gaze.
translation:
@@U03648@@
我也来吧

@@U03650@@
这是多么了不起的三位一体啊！
神、人、灵都步调一致！
（罗得岛的忒尔喀涅斯众神出现在海马和海龙上，
挥舞涅普顿：三叉戟。）

@@U03652@@
我们为涅普顿铸造了这把三叉戟，
他用它统治着最狂野的波浪。
当雷霆释放他孕育的云彩时，
涅普顿回应可怕的隆隆声
激起大海的剧烈反应。
当闪电锯齿状地向下坠落时，
涅普顿的波浪向上冲去，
向韦伊挥手，
山高。
船上的任何人都夹在中间
被翻腾和风吹，直到大海淹没他们，
将他们拖入大海的深处。
所以，他今天把他的权杖借给了我们，
让我们在玩耍中感到平静和快乐。

@@U03654@@
欢迎，赫利俄斯的信徒们，
尊崇光的人有福了，
加入我们，纪念露娜，
光荣的黑夜女神！

@@U03656@@
在你的轨道上最亲爱的女神，
当你听到你的兄弟受到赞扬时，你是多么高兴，
侧耳倾听保佑罗得岛，
歌颂他的赞歌永不停歇。
在他每日回合的开始和结束时，
他用火热的目光俯视着我们。
